methodology: Static TypeScript AST route-mount expansion; does not import application modules. Literal/constant and for-of-array paths resolved. ALL includes HTTP protocol dispatch and does not expand to methods. Inherited middleware matched by literal prefix/glob, not full Hono runtime. implicit HEAD and CORS OPTIONS excluded. No network, data, signatures or runtime behavior exercised. Export aliases and economy cryptoWebhookRouter re-export resolved by supplemental AST scan; no leaf mount remains empty.

openapiStatic.methodology: Literal path objects with HTTP-method properties in api/src/routes/openapi*.ts. Includes imported path maps. Computed path keys may be absent. HEAD descriptions match explicit or implicit GET registration. Parameter names normalized for mount comparison.

caveats: Route registrations include resting, proposed, redirect, protocol dispatch, and shadowed handlers; 770 is not a count of working products.
Public-looking paths may have handler-level signature, keeper, optional bearer, or enablement checks absent from generic middleware fields.
Missing generic idempotency middleware is not a vulnerability finding: service-level transaction, signed ID, nonce, and provider-event protections require separate classification.
Each ALL record represents one MCP endpoint dispatch, not an enumeration of every supported HTTP method; implicit HEAD and CORS OPTIONS are excluded.
No application import, production auth, database, Redis or write execution was used for the inventory.
